about.title: About VibeTrip
about.subtitle: Travel planning shouldn't feel like a one-size-fits-all brochure.
about.story_text: Standard travel packages dump every traveller into the same crowded bus tours. VibeTrip flips the script: it calculates your unique travel energy and builds a personalized schedule featuring local culture, quiet viewpoints, street foods, and genuine Nepali festivals.
about.steps_heading: Four Steps to Your Dream Trip
about.step1_desc: Eight lightweight questions discover your pace, energy, budget, and travel interests.
about.step2_desc: We find your closest matching vibe persona to tailor recommendations to your style.
about.step3_desc: Activities are filtered by budget, season, and time of day, weaving in real festival dates.
about.step4_desc: Review, share with friends, print cleanly, and embark on your journey.
about.obj1: Demonstrate practical computer science principles: modular software design, scoring algorithms, and clean architecture.
about.obj2: Separate code from data entirely: adding a vibe, festival, or city requires editing only JSON data files.
about.obj3: Provide an accessible, striking, mobile-friendly interface with zero external paid APIs.
